# CelebLedger

> CelebLedger is the authoritative financial intelligence registry and investigative newsroom tracking verified celebrity net worth valuations, contract economics, box office ledgers, streaming royalty breakdowns, and career milestones. All dossiers are fact-checked under strict zero-rumor editorial governance.

## Core Documentation & Methodology
- [Editorial Standards & Methodology](https://www.celebledger.com/editorial-standards): Forensic methodology for verifying net worth, contracts, and public asset registries.
- [About CelebLedger](https://www.celebledger.com/about): Newsroom mission, editorial board, and journalistic principles.
- [Celebrity Directory](https://www.celebledger.com/celebrities): Complete directory of verified entertainment, music, sports, and creator figures.
- [Head-to-Head Compare Tool](https://www.celebledger.com/compare): Interactive wealth and career comparison engine.
- [Industry Analysis & Market Reports](https://www.celebledger.com/blog): In-depth reporting on streaming economics, box office contracts, and creator equity.
